articles.zh: 稳住，我罩着你：got you 怎么用
body: When someone says "I've got you", they mean they will support or protect you.
当有人说「I've got you」，意思是他/她会支持或保护你。
It is common in moments of worry, when a friend wants to show they will not let you fall.
常出现在让人担心的时刻，朋友想表达「我不会让你掉下去」。
You can use it to comfort someone, or to say you have a situation under control.
你可以用它来安慰别人，或表示某件事你稳稳hold住了。
tips: 我罩着你 / 别怕，有我

articles.zh: 心流状态：flow state 是什么意思
body: A "flow state" is a moment when you are so focused on a task that time seems to disappear.
flow state 指你全神贯注做一件事，连时间都像消失了的那种状态。
People often reach it while doing something they enjoy, like playing music, painting, or writing.
人常在喜欢的事里进入这种状态，比如弹琴、画画或写作。
Because attention is total, work feels easier and more skilful than usual.
因为注意力完全集中，事情做起来比平时更顺、更出彩。

articles.zh: 别一直碎碎念：yap 是什么意思
body: "Yap" means to talk a lot, often in a noisy or annoying way.
yap 指说个不停，常带点吵闹或讨人烦的意味。
You might hear "Stop yapping!" when someone wants you to be quiet.
当有人想让你闭嘴时，可能会说「Stop yapping!」（别碎碎念了！）。
It is a casual word, so use it with friends rather than in formal situations.
这是个很口语的词，适合跟朋友用，正式场合别用。
tips: 别唠叨了 / 闭嘴碎碎念

articles.zh: 英语里带 thing 的短语
body: English has several short phrases built around the word "thing".
英语里有很多围绕 thing 这个词构成的短语。
"A thing of the past" means something that no longer happens, while "the next big thing" means a future hit.
a thing of the past 指已经不再发生的事，而 the next big thing 指未来的大热门。
"No such thing" denies that something exists, and "in the thick of things" means being at the busy centre of action.
no such thing 表示「没这回事」，in the thick of things 则指身处事务的中心、忙得团团转。
tips: 身处事务中心 / 忙得不可开交

articles.en: Can't see the wood for the trees
articles.zh: 见树不见林：这个习语怎么用
body: This idiom means you focus so much on small details that you miss the bigger picture.
这个习语指你太盯着细枝末节，反而看不见整体大局。
It is useful when someone is lost in minor problems and forgets the main goal.
当有人陷在小事里、忘了主要目标时，这句话很好用。
In American English, people say "can't see the forest for the trees" with the same meaning.
美式英语里说「can't see the forest for the trees」，意思完全一样。
